front.transcription:
PART 1
THIS IS THE LEGACY DECK
Read the rules (Read page 3 aloud to all players), then draw this card during Step 1 of Setup for your Prologue game.

back.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING
"Agents: it's time to head out. It's okay to be a little nervous; every new agent is. This one's pretty straightforward though: we have intel on a sample of the MEDUSA plague somewhere in Europe and a sighting of Agent Sabik in Novosibirsk. Couple of reminders here before you go:

First, try to keep a handle on Soviet agents, but remember that your teams will do a lot of that heavy lifting once you set 'em up. Second, don't forget that flying to Allied countries is easy; we've paid off all the right people. If you need to go somewhere friendly to the Reds, you can do it, but flying won't be easy."

front.transcription:
RIGHT NOW
Draw the next 2 cards. They are your prologue objectives. Set up these objectives following the instructions printed on them.

When you complete or fail an objective, remember to immediately read its debrief entry in the Debrief book (even if it is the end of the game).

Also remember that the number of cities in each region and of each affiliation are shown in the reference area of the game board.

This objective has an unknown target city.

To set it up, separate the 11 Europe City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 1 of them facedown into the Operations area.

Then shuffle the remaining Europe cards back into the Player deck without looking at them.

Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the unknown City card.

STOP
Draw this card just before you set up your first game in January.

back.transcription:
"All right team, say hello to the new you. This is the alias you'll be using for the time bein'."

Take the 4 passports. Choose a set of 3 photos and place 1 on each alias of the passport. Then, on the first page (the one with the ✦ star) give each alias a name. Add a Cover Occupation sticker to each alias. Leave the Specialization empty for now. Modify its appearance using Disguise stickers.

When you have finished making your aliases, continue reading.
back.flavor: "All right team, say hello to the new you. This is the alias you'll be using for the time bein'."

front.transcription:
"I'll get you a second alias once you're comfortable with this one.

Here are the month's objectives: Agent Sabik is still in Asia, and we gotta track him down. Also, two Soviet scientists from the Project MEDUSA research team are in South America. Might be we can catch up to 'em and get some intel."

front.transcription:
"Last thing, I got a bit of Langley protocol. Yeah, I know I promised to keep you clear of the red tape, but I actually think this is pretty important.

We like to keep track of your mental state as you work in the field. You'll be called upon to make decisions, and believe me, things can get complicated. Answer these three questions truthfully as a team, and it'll help us figure out how best to support your development as agents moving forward."

back.transcription:
Decide as a group, then fill in one bubble per question.

1. We often consider the consequences before we take action. AGREE DISAGREE
2. We tend to blame ourselves when something goes wrong. AGREE DISAGREE
3. We are willing to manipulate people to get what we want. AGREE DISAGREE

After answering, put this card into your Personnel file.
